source.document: Mercedes-Benz service information via Xentry — trigger language reproduced from MB service info as documented in Opus ADAS inspection reports. Additional reference: MBUSA Certified Collision Program Position Statement.

source.note: Xentry scan tool is required for all calibration and SCN programming procedures. Xentry must be connected throughout dynamic calibration drive cycles.

general_requirements: Per MBUSA position statement: as of model year 1996 (OBDII), vehicles involved in a collision repair should have these systems evaluated using an up-to-date Xentry Kit diagnostics computer. Pre-repair scanning and diagnosis is highly recommended. Post-repair scanning and diagnosis is necessary to ensure safety and driver-assist systems are operable and fully functioning. Many safety and driver-assist systems may have been activated during a collision and require vehicle calibration, normalization, or coding.

components.calibration_note: ADAS targets are NOT required for system calibration. Xentry will need to be connected throughout the dynamic calibration drive cycle.
